title: Question and answer polish sweep E6: Questions group, option wrap, dash in Recommend, answer-pane gaps
lead: The Needs you list gets a `Questions` group for runs that wait on an owner question, structured question options wrap with a hang and never drop silently in a short pane, `Recommend: N` accepts an en or em dash, and the answer panes close a set of small gaps found in the S111, S185 and S112 reviews.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Owner decision 2026-10-31: later-notes rows fold into sweep slices, and the group heading that replaces `Paused` for runs waiting on an owner question is `Questions` (S132). This slice is hosted on S132 and folds S132, S202 (S185 later notes) and S203 items 2 to 5 (S112 later notes). S203 item 1 (answers that start with a dash, rejected by slicer's argparse) goes to another slice's correctness sweep and is not here. Each item was re-checked against the code at HEAD of main on 2026-10-31. S132's Files include `internal/engine/report.go`, and item 12 is in `internal/daemon`, so this slice is an engine, daemon and TUI slice (E-class); it can pair with an N-class slice only.

Items:

1. **A `Questions` group** (S132, owner decision). The Needs you groups put rows of kind `= paused` and `? question` together under `Paused` (`internal/tui/overview.go:545-548`, order list `:560`). Rows of kind `? question` move to a new group `Questions`. *Proposed* position: directly before `Paused` (S132 gives none). Rows of kind `= paused` stay under `Paused`. This changes the group list that `docs/dashboard.md:363,425,694` and adj 149 (`ui.overview-layout`) name.
2. **Wrapped option text hangs** (S132). In the answer pane a long option wraps to the pane edge with no indent (`internal/tui/pane.go:476-483,493-499`), so its second line looks like a new option.
3. **Options never drop silently in a short pane** (S132). Option lines have priority 0, the lowest drop priority, so on a pane of 3 to 6 lines the footer loop removes the last option lines one by one with no sign (`internal/tui/pane.go:598-614`). Each option becomes one group that drops whole, and when options are left out the last visible footer line reads `+N more options` (*proposed* wording).
4. **`Recommend: N` accepts an en or em dash** (S132). `recommendLine` takes only the ASCII hyphen (`internal/engine/report.go:177`, used at `:224`); a role that writes `Recommend: 2 – reason` gets a shape error and a full rerun. The same parser reads owner findings (`internal/engine/kinds.go:181`).
5. **Pinning tests for digits** (S132). An out-of-range digit does nothing and digits after `t` go to the field (`internal/tui/pane.go:296-315`); no test says so.
6. **Refusal codes in the decision-answer test** (S202 item 1). `TestDecisionAnswerRefusalAndPending` fakes `CodeRefused` (`internal/tui/decisionanswer_test.go:142`); the daemon sends `bad_params` for an unset `By` (`internal/daemon/adjwrite.go:25-27`, through `engine.ValidateRecordAnswer`, `internal/engine/adjrecord.go:25`) and a plain error for an adj failure.
7. **Open a record through `openQuestion` in the Questions-view answer test** (S202 item 2; `internal/tui/questions.go:70-80`).
8. **Cancelling the confirmation keeps the typed free answer** (S202 item 3). `requestDecision` sets `m.decisionInput = nil` before the confirmation (`internal/tui/decisionanswer.go:106`), so `n` or `esc` throws the owner's text away.
9. **Help on a record with no options** (S202 item 5). The help line reads `1-0 pick an adj option; ...` for an answerable record with no options (`internal/tui/view.go:840-842`, `min(len(Options), 4)` is 0).
10. **Record options hang under their label, and an empty summary leaves no colon** (S202 item 7). `recordOptions` wraps continuation lines under the list indent and writes `label: ` with a trailing colon when the summary is empty (`internal/tui/decisions.go:181-202`).
11. **Ledger option with an empty summary** (S203 item 3). `1. Files: ` shows a trailing colon (`internal/tui/pane.go:476-483`).
12. **The relay answer keeps its channel** (S203 item 2). `RelayAnswerParams.Via` is validated as `cli` or `tui` (`internal/daemon/relayanswer.go:31-33`) but the adj answer it files always says `Via: "tui"` (`:107`), so the adj rationale says `tui` for a CLI answer.

Dropped, with the reason:

- S132 "alert wording `! owner questions 1` should read `! 1 owner question`": the alert is `? owner questions N` today, in the same `label N` form as `x stopped N` and `Running N` (`internal/tui/overview.go:773,1883`), and about ten tests and four goldens pin it (`internal/tui/running_test.go:297,1970,2059`). Changing it is a wording decision for the owner; asked in the manifest, not built here.
- S202 item 4 (an open record pane does not follow the snapshot): no defined behavior; the engine already refuses a stale answer. Item 6 (success shows `decided #ID in adj` and drops the daemon message): conditional on adj returning notices. Item 8 (free-text field shows no sign of scrolled text, could name the record): layout choice with no defect. The "side effect of fix 1" note needs no work.
- S203 item 4 (option 5 and later numbered but no key): slicer limits a question to 4 options (`../slicer/src/slicer/relayrun.py:80-82`), so it cannot occur through the ledger. Item 5 (long run id wraps mid-word; inline header shrinks to `Run`): needs a header-versus-footer priority decision (`internal/tui/pane.go:391,616`).
- S203 item 1: another slice's correctness sweep (owner instruction).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestNeedsYouQuestionRowsFormTheQuestionsGroup` (`internal/tui/tui_test.go`): a model with one engine run paused on a question and one paused for another reason shows `Questions 1` and `Paused 1` in that order, between `Stopped` and `Approve`, each with its own row; `TestNeedsYouGroupsByKind` still passes. Fails first: both rows are under `Paused 2`.
- `TestWrappedOptionIndents` (`internal/tui/pane_test.go`): at 50 columns a 100-character option summary wraps and its second line starts with the option's text column (3 spaces for `1. `), not at the pane edge. Fails first: no indent.
- `TestFourOptionsInShortPaneNeverDropSilently`: with a 4-option question and pane heights 3, 4, 5 and 6, either all four options show or the last footer line is `+N more options` with N the number hidden, and the shown options are whole (never half a wrapped option). Fails first: options 3 and 4 vanish with no marker.
- `TestRecommendAcceptsDashes` (`internal/engine/report_test.go`): `Recommend: 1 - r`, `Recommend: 1 – r` (en dash) and `Recommend: 1 — r` (em dash) each parse with reason `r`; `Recommend: 1 r` and `Recommend: 1 -- r` stay shape errors. Fails first: the en and em dash cases are shape errors. `TestOwnerFindingWithAnEnDashKeepsItsAsk` (`kinds_test.go`): an owner finding with an en dash keeps its `Ask`.
- `TestOutOfRangeDigitDoesNothing` and `TestDigitsAfterTReachTheField` (`internal/tui/pane_test.go`): on a 2-option question `4` changes nothing (no confirmation, no status); after `t`, `1` and `2` go into the free-text field. These pin today's behavior and pass on arrival.
- `TestDecisionAnswerErrorCodes` (`internal/tui/decisionanswer_test.go`): `bad_params` (unset `By`), a plain error and `refused` each keep the pane and show the daemon's text in the status: `refused` as its message alone, `bad_params` as `bad_params: MESSAGE` with the leading `bad params: ` said once (`actionError`, `internal/tui/model.go`), a plain error as it is. All three pass on arrival: the brief's word verbatim holds for the message, but `actionError` prefixes the code of every coded error other than `refused`.
- `TestQuestionsViewAnswerOpensThroughOpenQuestion` (`internal/tui/questions_test.go`): the answer test opens the record with `openQuestion` (Enter on the row), not by setting the pane. It passes on arrival (no product change).
- `TestCancelledDecisionConfirmationKeepsTheFreeAnswer` (`internal/tui/decisionanswer_test.go`): press `t`, type `keep files`, Enter, then `n`: the field is open again with `keep files`; `esc` then closes it. Fails first: the field is gone and the text lost.
- `TestHelpOnAnOptionlessRecordOffersNoPick` (`internal/tui/decisionanswer_test.go`): the help for an answerable record with no options has no `1-0` line and still offers `t`. Fails first: `1-0 pick an adj option`.
- `TestRecordOptionsHangUnderTheirLabel` and `TestRecordOptionWithAnEmptySummaryHasNoColon` (`internal/tui/decisions_test.go`): a long numbered option's second line starts under the label text; `label` alone, with no `: `, when the summary is empty. Fails first: no hang, trailing colon.
- `TestLedgerOptionWithAnEmptySummaryHasNoColon` (`internal/tui/pane_test.go`): `1. file` with no trailing `: `. Fails first: `1. file:  (recommended)`.
- `TestDaemonRelayAnswerPassesViaToAdj` (`internal/daemon/relayanswer_test.go`): a request with `Via` `cli` files the adj answer with `Answered in ork (cli)` in its rationale; `tui` says `tui`. Fails first: always `tui`.
- Goldens: `go test ./internal/tui` passes after the reviewed `-update`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Tests first; watch each go red for the reason given. Re-anchor every cited line in the worktree before editing.

1. `internal/engine/report.go`: change `recommendLine` to `^Recommend: ([1-4]) [-–—] (.+)$` (a character class with the ASCII hyphen, en dash and em dash). Do not change the prompts or the parser's other rules.
2. `internal/daemon/relayanswer.go`: pass `p.Via` to `AnswerRecord`. The validation at `:31-33` already limits it.
3. `internal/tui/overview.go`: map kind `? question` to group `Questions`, `= paused` to `Paused`; insert `Questions` before `Paused` in `needsGroups`.
4. `internal/tui/pane.go`: write one helper that wraps an option line with a hang (continuation lines indented to the text column after `N. `) and omits `: ` when the summary is empty; use it for the engine question, the ledger question and (through `recordOptions`'s own hang) the decision options in `decisions.go`. Add each option to the footer with `addGroup(lines, 0, true)`. After the drop loop, count the options whose group is gone; when N > 0, replace the last footer line with `+N more options` (dim), keeping the footer within `limit`. Keep priorities of the other lines as they are.
5. `internal/tui/decisionanswer.go`: keep the typed text across the confirmation (a draft field on the model, restored into `decisionInput` when the confirmation is cancelled; cleared when the answer is sent or the pane closes). `internal/tui/view.go`: skip the `1-N pick` help line when the record has no options.
6. Tests for items 5, 6, 7 are listed above; item 7 uses `openQuestion`.
7. Run `go test ./internal/tui -update` once, review every diff in `testdata/golden/`, and keep only the ones that show the new group, the hang or the marker.
8. Docs: group lists and the Needs you description (`docs/dashboard.md`), the `Recommend:` shape (`docs/design.md:346,537`: the hyphen, en dash or em dash), the question pane (hang, `+N more options`). Mark new behavior *proposed*.
9. CHANGELOG last, so a parallel slice's entry does not conflict: one bullet under `## Unreleased` starting "S132:", *proposed*.

Do not change the alert wording, role prompts, `internal/tui/overview.go:773,1883`, slicer or adj. No new dependency.

UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -race -count=1 ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `gofmt -l .`, `slicer check`, `adj lint`.
- `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/engine ./internal/daemon ./internal/tui` passes; `git diff --stat -- testdata/golden` lists only goldens that show a question row, a wrapped option or the marker.
- `rg -n "Recommend: " docs/design.md` shows the dash note at the two lines named.
- [HUMAN CHECK] At 100x30 and 80x24, with a run paused on a structured question and another paused on an error: the Overview shows `Questions 1` and `Paused 1` in that order; open the question pane, shrink the terminal to a short height and see `+N more options` instead of silently missing options; wrapped options hang under their text.
- [HUMAN CHECK] In the Decisions pane of an open record, press `t`, type, Enter, `n`: the typed answer is still in the field.
